narrative.details: Light erupts as the final word leaves your lips. The hiss of water turning to mist fades into silence, and your senses reel as the corrupt spirits around you unravel, their essence scattered like ash in the wind.
narrative.objectives: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in Westfall.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thanks to you. Thanks to the shamans.Corruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to shamans to protect life.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 22 to 23, 8,815 XP in all.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.objectiveText: Find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.objectiveText: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the bottom of the waterfalls below Hervdana's cave and return it to her in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.objectiveText: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at Stonewatch Falls near the Nightcrawler Murlocs and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.objectiveText: Fill the Unfilled Blue Waterskin at the waters of Astranaar in Ashenvale and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Vial of Purest Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.objectiveText: Cleanse the corruption at Stendel's Pond in Westfall.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.objectiveText: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in Westfall.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Shard of Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
